hypotheses.claim: Current grammar.ebnf is not syntactically aligned with current G9 V3 source constructs: it lacks type-level union syntax and explicit if statements used by the current spec.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The mismatch is an artifact of the proxy EBNF-to-Lark translation rather than the source grammar.
hypotheses.falsifier: A parser generated directly from current grammar.ebnf parses the cited current-source constructs without grammar extension.
hypotheses.action: Patch/freeze grammar-parser surface only after full-corpus conformance; do not redesign ClayCode semantics from this defect.

hypotheses.claim: WASI Component Model/WIT is a strong first candidate for ClayCode typed FFI/component lowering, while Clay capability authorization remains outside WIT.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A native ABI or WASI/native hybrid yields lower complexity and better semantic/latency fidelity for the first BASE release.
hypotheses.falsifier: APP-02/APP-04/APP-07 lowering benchmarks show material semantic gaps, excessive adapter complexity, or worse latency/repair cost than alternatives.
evidence: Bytecode Alliance Component Model WIT/world/resource documentation (external primary documentation)
hypotheses.action: Do not promote; benchmark in WP-06/WP-07 after parser/IR freeze.

hypotheses.claim: Existing G9-compatible typed records/type aliases/rules are sufficient to represent and lower the current fused FRANK RecognitionValidity, AdaptiveStatePromotion and semantic-publication gate logic without dedicated new language primitives.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The real Retina/Unified-Memory state machine will require a new core primitive once versioned state, asynchronous learning, rollback/replay, transactional publication and effects are compiled together.
hypotheses.falsifier: A real frozen Retina/Unified-Memory component fails to type/check/lower/replay without an opaque host-only state or semantic escape hatch under the frozen BASE parser/IR.
hypotheses.action: No primitive growth. Compile the real component next; reopen semantics only on executable inadequacy.
